focus: ARCHITECTURE ONLY — how the game is coded/structured. NEVER ask game-rules questions (see daily-prompt.md).
difficultyScale: 1 = gentlest (what is a function, what is a package). 5 = deep (trace an event through the architecture). Ramp only per the rules in daily-prompt.md.

curriculum.title: What a function is
curriculum.hint: Use simulate() in packages/core/src/combat/simulate.ts as the concrete example: inputs -> output.

curriculum.title: The core split: deterministic sim, decoupled from the UI
curriculum.hint: CLAUDE.md 'Architecture': the sim computes outcomes; the UI only animates them. The single most important architectural idea.

curriculum.title: The monorepo: core / content / sim / ui / tools
curriculum.hint: CLAUDE.md 'Monorepo': what each package owns and the dependency direction (ui -> all, core -> nothing).

curriculum.title: What 'deterministic' means in the engine
curriculum.hint: Same inputs -> same outputs, every time. Why replays + shareable seeds work.

curriculum.title: The seeded RNG (mulberry32) and fork()
curriculum.hint: packages/core/src/rng.ts. One RNG threaded via fork(); Math.random is banned.

curriculum.title: Pure functions (no side effects)
curriculum.hint: simulate() returns { events, result, ... }; it never mutates outside state or touches the DOM.

curriculum.title: Data-driven cards: data vs code
curriculum.hint: Cards are data + effect subscriptions (zod-validated), not bespoke classes. packages/content/src.

curriculum.title: The event log + replay architecture
curriculum.hint: simulate emits an events array; the UI animates the log on its own clock and never computes outcomes.

curriculum.title: TypeScript types and unions
curriculum.hint: packages/core/src/types.ts; the CombatEvent union is the source of truth for the combat vocabulary.

curriculum.title: Immutability: never mutate shared CardDefs
curriculum.hint: Clone CardDefs into combat Minion instances; the reducer shares lastCombat by reference.

curriculum.title: The reducer + run state
curriculum.hint: packages/sim/src/reducer.ts + state.ts drive a run's state transitions.

curriculum.title: UI state with Zustand
curriculum.hint: packages/ui/src/store.ts holds presentation state, separate from sim state.

curriculum.title: The event bus / event vocabulary
curriculum.hint: packages/core/src/events.ts + the CombatEvent union in types.ts.

curriculum.title: How cards are organized into SETS
curriculum.hint: packages/content/src/sets.ts; a run pins its set and reads it via poolOf(state). Code organization, not rules.

curriculum.title: Package boundaries + public entrypoints
curriculum.hint: CLAUDE.md: ui depends on others only through public package entrypoints; importing an internal leaks the boundary.

curriculum.title: Effects as data subscriptions (factories)
curriculum.hint: Battlecry/Deathrattle etc. are effect factories whitelisted in the content schema, not classes.

curriculum.title: Effect timing: recruit-phase bake vs combat-time
curriculum.hint: Recruit effects bake into stats before combat; the simulator runs combat-time effects. Architecture of WHEN effects apply.

curriculum.title: Testing: vitest, determinism + golden tests
curriculum.hint: npm test; determinism/golden tests lock engine behavior against regressions.

curriculum.title: Lint rules that protect the architecture
curriculum.hint: The Math.random ban is ESLint-enforced in core/content/sim to keep the sim deterministic.

curriculum.title: Performance architecture: React.memo + stable props
curriculum.hint: docs/performance.md; memoized list items, animate transform/opacity only.
